login_css.body::after: background: url(./img/logob.png); background-size: auto 100%; width: 100%; height: 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; opacity: 0.05;
login_css..lgbox: top: 50%; left: 60%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 300px; background-color: #ffffff; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: -2px 6px 53px -23px rgba(0,0,0,0.75); padding: 14px 16px; font-size: smaller;
login_css..langbox: bottom: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: max-content; color: white;
login_css..advtextbox: top: 50%; left: 7%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: 43%; color: #0c0d0e;
login_css..advtextbox > p: font-weight: 400; font-family: 'Raleway'; font-size: smaller; background-color: #ffffff; color: black; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 5px 10px 5px; width: 120px; left: calc(50% - 60px); margin-top: 30px;
login_css.span#signin: top: 40px; right: 100px; position: absolute; font-size: 0.8em; font-weight: 500; color: #0c0d0e;

en.title: Monkvision Dashboards
en.loginsubtag: World's only enterprise-wide AI based active monitorting solution.

main_css.div#leftheader: width: 58px; background-color: #D9D9D9; border-right: 1px solid #DCDCDC; padding-top: 10px; overflow-y: auto; overflow-x: hidden;
main_css.div#leftheader .dash-row: position: relative; height: 46px; padding: 0 10px; gap: 12px; margin: 4px 0; border-radius: 0.3em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
main_css.span#header: color: #DCDCDC; font-family: 'Red Hat Text'; background-color: #818181; padding: 0.5em 1em; margin-bottom: 0.5em; gap: 1em;
main_css.span#header > span#title: width: 300px; font-size: 0.85em; font-weight: 500; background-color: #4C4C4C; color: #DCDCDC; padding: 0.5em 0.8em; border-radius: 0.2em; border-bottom: 2px solid #BC5205;
main_css.input#datetimepickerfrom, input#datetime: font-size: 0.8em; font-family: 'Red Hat Text'; color: #4C4C4C; background-color: #F2FAFF; border-radius: 0.4em; padding: 4px 6px; border-style: none; outline: none;
main_css.span#header img#playpause:hover, span#he: filter: brightness(0) invert(1); transition: all 0.3s ease;

main_html_data.span-with-menu#gear: styleBody='div.menuitem:hover{background: #BC5205 !important; color: #F3F3F3 !important;} span#content > img{filter: brightness(0) invert(0.86);} span#content > img:hover{filter: brightness(0) invert(1);transition: all 0.3s ease;} div#menu{margin-left: -120px;}'
main_html_data.span-with-menu#toggle-theme: styleBody='div.menuitem:hover{background: #BC5205 !important; color: #F3F3F3 !important;} span#content > img{filter: brightness(0) invert(0.86);} span#content > img:hover{filter: brightness(0) invert(1);transition: all 0.3s ease;} div#menu{margin-left: -40px;}'
main_html_data.ChartBoxStyle: div#container{font-family: inherit;} p#title{margin: -10px -10px 10px -10px; padding: 0.6em 1em; background-color: #4C4C4C; color: #DCDCDC; text-align: left; font-size: 0.9em; font-weight: 500;} div#content{overflow-y: hidden; height: calc(100% - 3em);}

pdf_report_css.input#datetimepickerfrom, input#datetime: font-size: 0.8em; font-family: sans-serif; color: rgba(0,0,0,0.75);border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 1px rgba(34, 25, 25, 0.4); padding: 2px; border-style: none; pointer-events: none;
pdf_report_css.div#pdf-preview-maincontent: top: 120px; width: calc(95vw - 100px); height: calc(100vh - 120px); left: 100px;
pdf_report_css.@media print: div#pdf-preview-container {display: none;} div#pdf-preview-maincontent{top: unset; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; left: unset;}
